player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id} i te kēmu Rock-Paper-Scissors e {num_rounds} ngā rauna.
Ko tōu whāinga ko te wikitoria i ngā rauna maha iho.
I ia rauna, whakautua ki tetahi o: '[rock]', '[paper]', '[scissors]'.
Ka taea hoki te whakamahi '[r]', '[p]', '[s]' hei kupu poto.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore te nekehanga i te tino mohio. Whakamahia [rock], [paper], [scissors] rānei.

game_action.selects: Ka whiriwhiri te kaitākaro {player_id} i tētahi nekehanga {move}.

message.round_draw: Te hua o te rauna: Whakatika.
message.round_win: Te hua o te rauna: Ka wikitoria e {winner} kaitākaro!

outcome.p0_wins: Ko te kaitākaro 0 i toa i ngā rauna!
outcome.p1_wins: Ko te kaitākaro 1 i toa ki ngā rauna!
